proximity-voice-chat.Settings.DefaultPro: The amount of units the radius will be. Example: 100
The units with which the Default Proximity Radius is measured.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.Debug.Hint: Logs every volume change, and why, to the browser console (F12).
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.FixPeerCon: Works around Foundry's built-in voice chat repeatedly replacing connections that take more than a few seconds to set up, which can leave people unable to hear each other. Everyone must reload after changing this.
proximity-voice-chat.UI.globalListen.On: Global Listening on: you hear everyone.
proximity-voice-chat.UI.globalListen.Off: Global Listening off: you hear players near your selected tokens, or near tokens you speak through if none are selected.
proximity-voice-chat.UI.globalSpeak.On: Global Speaking on: everyone hears you.
proximity-voice-chat.UI.globalSpeak.Off: Global Speaking off: players hear you only near the tokens you have selected, or tokens you've added yourself to with the token HUD.
proximity-voice-chat.UI.StaleScript: Proximity Voice Chat: this browser is running an old cached copy of the module script ({script}) but {installed} is installed. Clear this site's cached files (Ctrl+Shift+Delete, "Cached images and files") and reload.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.HideCamera: Hide Foundry's camera dock for everyone. Voice keeps working; speaking cues and voice controls move to the tokens and the players list. Players can bring the dock back for themselves.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.ShowCamera: Show Foundry's camera dock on this device even if the GM has hidden it, e.g. to see video.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.SpeakingIn: How tokens show that the person speaking through them is talking. This is the table default; players can choose their own.
Your own choice of speaking cue, overriding the GM's default on this device.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.OwnersSpea: Players speak through tokens of their assigned character, and of actors they've been given Owner permission on, without being added to the token's speaker list. Default "all players" ownership doesn't count.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.SpeakingTh: How loud someone's voice must be, as you receive it, to show a speaking cue. Lower is more sensitive; raise it if background noise lights people up. Doesn't affect when anyone transmits.
proximity-voice-chat.Token.ListenList.La: Who also listens through this token
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.WhisperRan: How far a whisper carries, as a percentage of the speaker's normal proximity radius.
How far a yell carries, as a percentage of the speaker's normal proximity radius.
proximity-voice-chat.UI.VoiceMode: Voice: {mode}. Click to cycle Normal, Whisper, Yell; right-click for Normal
proximity-voice-chat.UI.ModeGlobalSpeaki: Global Speaking is on, so everyone still hears you. Turn it off to whisper or yell.
proximity-voice-chat.Keybindings.ModeHin: Tap to switch and stay; tap again for Normal. Hold while talking to switch back when you let go.
proximity-voice-chat.SelfTest.webrtc-dis: Proximity Voice Chat: WebRTC is disabled in this browser, so voice chat can't work. In Firefox, open about:config and check that media.peerconnection.enabled is true and media.peerconnection.ice.default_address_only, .no_host, .relay_only and .proxy_only are false (a user.js file can reset these on restart). Privacy extensions that block WebRTC can cause this too.
proximity-voice-chat.SelfTest.no-address: Proximity Voice Chat: this browser isn't offering any network addresses for voice chat, so nobody can connect to you. In Firefox, open about:config and check that media.peerconnection.enabled is true and media.peerconnection.ice.default_address_only, .no_host, .relay_only and .proxy_only are false (a user.js file can reset these on restart). Privacy extensions that block WebRTC can cause this too.
proximity-voice-chat.SelfTest.relay-unre: Proximity Voice Chat: the relay (TURN) server in the audio/video settings isn't reachable from this browser. Check its URL (it must start with turn:), username, password, and the server's firewall and port forwards.
proximity-voice-chat.SelfTest.relay-ok: Proximity Voice Chat: the relay (TURN) server is reachable from this browser.
proximity-voice-chat.SelfTest.Player.web: Proximity Voice Chat: {name}'s browser has WebRTC disabled, so they can't hear or be heard. They need to re-enable it (Firefox: media.peerconnection.enabled in about:config) or use another browser.
proximity-voice-chat.SelfTest.Player.no-: Proximity Voice Chat: {name}'s browser isn't offering any network addresses, so nobody can connect to them. Likely a privacy setting or extension; Firefox users should check media.peerconnection.ice.* in about:config.
proximity-voice-chat.SelfTest.Player.rel: Proximity Voice Chat: the relay (TURN) server isn't reachable from {name}'s browser. Their network may block it, or the server isn't reachable from outside.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Title: Voice Diagnostics
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Menu.Hi: Check whether your voice chat is working, and send the results to the GM.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.NoReply: No voice diagnostics came back from {name}. They may have closed Foundry, or their browser is running an old cached copy of the module (they should reload).
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.RanByGM: {name} (GM) ran voice diagnostics on your browser to help troubleshoot voice chat.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Sent: Voice diagnostics sent to the GM.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.NoGM: No GM is online to receive it. Use Copy Report and send it to your GM another way.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Copied: Voice diagnostics copied to the clipboard.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Summary: Voice is working: connected to {connected} of {total} players.
Problems found: connected to {connected} of {total} players.
No one else is online yet.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.VoiceOf: Voice chat is turned off for this world (Configure Audio/Video).
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Deafene: You've deafened yourself, so you can't hear anyone.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Peer.Ow: Can't connect: your browser can't make voice connections (see above).
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Peer.No: No voice connection. If it doesn't appear within a minute, tell the GM.
Voice connection failed to start ({state}). Usually a network problem; a relay server fixes most cases.
Connected, but there's no audio player for them. Try reloading.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Peer.Pa: Connected, but their audio is paused. Click anywhere on the page.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Peer.Ca: Connected; you can't hear them right now: {reason}.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Peer.No: Connected, but they aren't sending any audio (no microphone, or it's turned off).
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Summary: Mostly working: connected to {connected} of {total} players, with a warning below.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.CopiedD: Diagnostic details copied to the clipboard.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Mic.Off: Your microphone is turned off in Foundry's audio/video settings (Configure Audio/Video → Devices).
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Mic.Den: Your browser is blocking the microphone for this site. Allow it via the icon left of the address bar, then reload.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Mic.Mis: The microphone selected in Foundry's audio/video settings isn't connected. Pick another in Configure Audio/Video → Devices.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Mic.Not: Your microphone isn't capturing any audio, so nobody can hear you. Check Configure Audio/Video → Devices, and that no other app has taken over the microphone.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Mic.Pus: You're on push-to-talk: others hear you only while you hold the key.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.FixOff: "Fix Voice Connection Drops" is off (Configure Settings → Proximity Voice Chat). Connections that are slow to set up may keep failing.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Peer.Hi: You've hidden them ("Hide User"), so their audio doesn't play.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Peer.No: Your audio isn't reaching them; try reloading.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Unhidde: {gm} (GM) showed {name} again in your voice chat; you had hidden them, so you couldn't hear them.
proximity-voice-chat.RelayTest.Reason.ca: the relay server is out of bandwidth capacity
proximity-voice-chat.RelayTest.Reason.cr: the relay server rejected the username or password
proximity-voice-chat.RelayTest.Reason.fo: the relay server refused the request
proximity-voice-chat.RelayTest.Reason.un: the relay server couldn't be reached from this network
proximity-voice-chat.RelayTest.Reason.ot: the relay server reported an error
proximity-voice-chat.RelayTest.Player.no: Proximity Voice Chat: {name}'s browser couldn't get a slot on the relay server, so connections that need the relay will fail for them.
Proximity Voice Chat: {name}'s browser got a relay slot, but nothing gets through the relay to you. Check the relay server's port forwards and firewall.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Relay.o: works ({rtt} ms round trip to the GM)
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Relay.n: The relay test couldn't get a slot on the relay server.
The relay test got a relay slot, but nothing gets through the relay. Tell the GM.
The relay test got no answer from the GM's browser, so it's inconclusive.
waiting for a GM to be online
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Relay.e: The relay test couldn't run in this browser.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.AdvancedAu: Plays voices through the browser's audio engine instead of Foundry's camera elements. That allows Voice Boost, muffling by tone instead of volume, and Directional Voice. A browser that can't do it falls back to the old way by itself, and each player can switch it off for themselves. Best with headphones: with speakers, some browsers don't cancel echo on this path.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.VoiceBoost: Makes every voice louder than Foundry can on its own. 100 is no boost. A limiter stops loud voices from distorting. Needs Advanced Voice Audio.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.LegacyAudi: Use the Old Audio Path on This Device
Plays voices the old way on this device only: no boost, no directional voice, and walls make voices quieter instead of muffled. Try this if voices sound wrong or echo here, e.g. on speakers.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.SoundPropa: Sound Travels Through and Around Walls

Voices pass through walls and closed doors muffled, by the amounts below, and carry around corners through open space. You hear whichever is clearer. Off: walls block voices completely, as before 2.0.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.Directiona: Places each voice to the left or right, by where the speaker's token is on screen relative to yours; around a corner, by where the corner is. For headphones. Needs Advanced Voice Audio.
How far to the side a voice can go. At 100, a voice directly to your left is in your left ear only.
proximity-voice-chat.Audio.Fallback: Proximity Voice Chat: advanced voice audio isn't working in this browser, so voices are playing the old way: no boost or directional voice, and walls make voices quieter instead of muffled.
proximity-voice-chat.Audio.Player.Fallba: Proximity Voice Chat: advanced voice audio isn't working in {name}'s browser, so they hear voices the old way: no boost or directional voice, and walls make voices quieter instead of muffled.
proximity-voice-chat.Audio.Reason.disabl: the GM has turned Advanced Voice Audio off
proximity-voice-chat.Audio.Reason.opted-: "Use the Old Audio Path on This Device" is on
proximity-voice-chat.Audio.Reason.waitin: waiting for a first click on the page
proximity-voice-chat.Audio.Reason.other-: another module is providing voice chat
proximity-voice-chat.Audio.Reason.unsupp: Reason: this browser doesn't support it.
proximity-voice-chat.Audio.Reason.resume: Reason: the browser wouldn't start its audio engine.
proximity-voice-chat.Audio.Reason.sink: Reason: the output device chosen in Configure Audio/Video couldn't be used. Choosing another there tries again.
proximity-voice-chat.Audio.Reason.error: Reason: an unexpected error; see the browser console.
proximity-voice-chat.Audio.Reason.voice-: this person's audio couldn't be routed
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Audio.W: Click anywhere on the page to start advanced voice audio. Until then voices play the old way.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.Muffle.lim: How much a voice is muffled each time it passes through walls whose sound restriction is Limited, such as thin partitions or foliage. 0 lets it through untouched; 100 blocks it completely, so it can only be heard around the wall.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.Muffle.nor: How much a voice is muffled each time it passes through ordinary walls. 0 lets it through untouched; 100 blocks it completely, so it can only be heard around the wall.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.Muffle.pro: How much a voice is muffled each time it passes through walls whose sound restriction is Proximity, while the speaker is too far from them to be heard through freely. 0 lets it through untouched; 100 blocks it completely, so it can only be heard around the wall.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.Muffle.dis: How much a voice is muffled each time it passes through walls whose sound restriction is Distance, while the speaker is too close to them to be heard through freely. 0 lets it through untouched; 100 blocks it completely, so it can only be heard around the wall.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.Muffle.doo: How much a voice is muffled each time it passes through closed doors. 0 lets it through untouched; 100 blocks it completely, so it can only be heard around the wall.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.Muffle.loc: How much a voice is muffled each time it passes through locked doors. 0 lets it through untouched; 100 blocks it completely, so it can only be heard around the wall.
proximity-voice-chat.Settings.Muffle.sec: How much a voice is muffled each time it passes through secret doors. Keep it the same as the wall around the door, or the door gives itself away by ear. 0 lets it through untouched; 100 blocks it completely, so it can only be heard around the wall.
proximity-voice-chat.Diagnostics.Propaga: Working out how sound travels through and around walls failed in this browser, so walls block voices completely here. Tell the GM.
